newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on export demand, tight cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on export demand, tight cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures posted double-digit gains on Tuesday, bolstered by tight cash markets and reports of export business in the works, traders said.
"Term Commodities was an aggressive buyer of the July and September," a floor source said. "There's a shortage of cash (supplies) right now."

Floor sources also noted trade reports that Costa Rican millers were privately negotiating with exporters to buy 26,500 tonnes of optional origin long grain rough rice. Results were expected by the end of the week. Costa Rica had previously cancelled several tenders for the same amount.
Rice ended 16 to 13 cents per cwt higher with July up 15-1/2 at $11.25-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 500 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 298 lots.
